description: Numerical auxiliary-name replacement agrees with substitution for the corresponding reserved name in the shared syntax.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.replaceAux_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n) (i : ℕ)
  (t : L.Term ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.replaceAux S n (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a) i
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.termCode S Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.auxName t) =
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S
      (a.subst fun j => if j = i then t else FirstOrder.Language.var j)
